scientific_integrity: Exact deterministic finite-dimensional theorem; analytic trace and Perron-monotonicity proof with exhaustive 720-word, 60-orbit certificate. Historical priority is provisional because not all plausible primary full texts were accessible.
scientific_limitations: Six distinct equally spaced fertility rates, deterministic fixed-order cycles, common positive juvenile maturation and adult carryover. Does not cover stochastic calendars, arbitrary fertility inventories, density dependence or transient optimization. Independent audit not performed.
title: A sharp six-season switch in worst-case juvenile–adult population growth
